name: k4_s19_elster
att: лист детей + k4_s19 (окно и ветка дерева снаружи)
note: Дерево и развилка — как на baum / baum_nest (приложить).
where: Spur 19 — сцена «Der Mond im Baum» (сейчас стоит просто дерево; старая картинка показывала уборку)
text:
Use the attached images as the exact reference for characters, places and style. Indoors always the same classroom as in the attached classroom image: the NATURAL WOOD puppet theater (light wood, two posts with round knobs, the top board is ONE smooth round arch – not wavy) on the big table with the red tablecloth, the window with the caterpillar's plant on the LEFT. Children's picture-book illustration in exactly the same style, landscape 3:2. No text, no letters, no numbers, no stars anywhere. Mila has no backpack. The hand puppets are a fox, a bear and a king – never a mouse (the only mouse in the book is Oskar's small grey PAPER mouse). The moon is always a FULL ROUND flat cardboard disc (never a crescent): yellow on the front, white on the back.
The caterpillar's antenna tips are plain yellow-green, NOT glowing.
Outside under the big tree in front of the classroom window: a black-and-white magpie with a very long tail has just landed in a tree fork (two thin branches forming a V right below the open window) and holds a white thread in its beak; on the thread hangs the round yellow cardboard moon with three brown paper spots, caught between the two thin branches. Below on the grass Mila, Ben and Oskar look up, surprised, pointing. On the windowsill above, the small green caterpillar watches. Warm autumn afternoon light.
